guards.rule: RL01 is an authorized snapshot, not admission permission. API045 re-resolves factory or returned basis from authoritative storage, compares epoch/gate/binding revision and candidateDigest, locks device rental uniqueness, and verifies current operator scope + exact recipient consent; no deviceId/accountId-only bypass.

Factory genesis requires provisioned device identity, approved inventory admission record, current virgin secure state evidence and never-previously-enrolled history. An old rental device, missing reset records, firmware reinstall or zero-looking epoch cannot become factory genesis. Returned basis requires exact latest completed job, cleanup evidence, nextEpoch and current eligible gate; no active/pending rental/binding/quarantine.

API045 atomically creates rental assigned, reserved binding, durable admission permit record, consumes gate/genesis once, advances gate/binding revisions, records idempotency/audit/outbox. It does not create wallet keys or enable signing. Tenant scope/recipient consent checked before idempotent replay. Persisted reservation survives token expiry, timeout and delivery uncertainty; no TTL auto-release.

Enrollment BLE session must authenticate exact trusted device and current enrollment holder under selected profile with explicit ephemeral key delivery/proof and no owner-role downgrade. Server resolves enrollmentProofRef to verified holder/session/recipient consent. AdmissionContext fixes enrollmentHolderThumbprint and enrollmentSessionId; permits bind exact device/epoch/rental/binding/recipient/holder/session; not sufficient as a bearer alone. Device validates signature, server trust, live session/recipient context, expected unprovisioned secure state and basis lineage; stages binding durably with signing disabled, emits device identity proof.

RL02 verifies BindingReceipt against immutable permit/context/digest/device identity and pending reservation; atomically persists activation permit + activation_issued and retains reservation exclusivity. Device activates only same staged binding under LB02, durable single activation, emits receipt. RL03 verifies receipt and atomically marks rental/binding/admission active. Device may have activated before server receipt: server-dependent spending remains blocked until active; recovery retries exact evidence, never assigns a second owner.

Admission GET never creates/resets a reservation. Only current scoped operator receives recoverable permits; exact recipient gets safe state with permit/activation null unless separately verified enrollment-holder capability exists. Historical records hide current next-account details. Holder session/bootstrap, recipient consent issuance and genesis attestation profiles remain explicit adoption prerequisites, not implemented routes.

RC01 requires current owner of exact still-active binding/epoch, job checking or prepared, no previously issued execution grant and no accepted/journaled execution evidence. Serialize under same device/job/fence locks as RT01. Winner cancel creates irreversible commit-block tombstone and cancellation intent + fixed permit. Original job phase stays checking/prepared with cancellation overlay until completion; RT01/API046 preparations denied while overlay exists. Owner navigation away is not cancel.

CB01 authenticates current owner session and signed exact cancel context; rejects any accepted execution grant/journal or newer epoch/binding. Atomically invalidates matching prepare/all old prepared sessions for that job and persists tombstone+CancelPrepared while retaining return fence. Already absent prepare requires positive identity/epoch and durable proof of never-accepted grant; missing/corrupt history is quarantine, not proof. Same permit returns same durable receipt across reboot.

RC02 verifies CancelPrepared and original never-issued history, retains server return fence, persists immutable ReleasePermit. CB02 accepts only matching durable cancel tombstone/prepare receipt/epoch/binding and release digest, atomically releases only this job return-fence reason and stores ReleaseReceipt. Other security/FOTA/administrative fences remain. Missing tombstone, lost marker or contradictory grant history cannot release.

RC03 verifies exact ReleaseReceipt and current job/binding/epoch under shared locks, atomically marks job aborted, cancellation completed, clears only own server return fence, restores pre-return rental usability if other gates allow, retains commit-block tombstone/receipts/idempotency/audit. No key erasure, epoch bump, enrollment reset or active rental removal. Aborted return is not reusable inventory.

RC01/02/03 and all retries check current owner authority before replay; sender/session anti-replay binds method/path/body digest/requestId/idempotency and device transport transcript under selected profile. Business keys scoped actor+operation+entity; transport nonce/proof rotation cannot change original business content. Device receipts immutable, server permits recoverable via protected GET; stale expectedRevision on exact idempotent replay returns original outcome with current state separately.

Same-device competing admission, return commit, cancellation and binding updates share one ordered authoritative gate boundary; cross-service transactions not assumed. Phase/cancellation overlays are checked by all issuance and signing entry points. Previously exposed signatures/dispatch permits are not revoked by fences; cancellation does not auto-resubmit or resurrect prior approval jobs.

No grantIssued true ever becomes false. Cancellation cannot be started or completed after grant issuance even when expired or apparently unused. Uncertain/crashed release stays pending/quarantined with exclusivity; no operator override or timed unlock. A new return job is allowed only after prior cancellation completed and fresh checks/physical preparation, new identifiers/revisions.

Response view is logically current and ACL-filtered; immutable context revisions identify initial operation, view.revision identifies progress. No mixed historical/new binding readiness. Signed permit validity, offline freshness, antirollback and durable receipt retention require selected profiles; unselected/unsupported profile fails closed.

Exactly one cancellation lineage per reset job: UNIQUE(jobId) across all states including completed/quarantined. Under shared lock RC01 first resolves existing cancellation before insert. Same business key replays original result; different key with existing lineage returns CANCELLATION_PENDING/safe original operation reference, never a new cancelId/permit/tombstone. No deletion or replacement to retry; another return attempt needs a new reset job only after cancellation completion.
